help.title: Help Center
help.description: Find quick reference guides, frequently asked questions, or get technical support.

faqs.a: AnyTrans is a professional document translation platform powered by state-of-the-art AI. Our core feature is preserving the original formatting, fonts, images, tables, and layouts of your documents perfectly after translation.

faqs.q: How do I translate my first document?
faqs.a: It's easy! Go to the 'Translate' page, drag & drop your document into the upload dropzone, select the source and target languages, customize any optional translation settings (such as Glossaries or custom Templates), and click 'Next' to start.
We support a wide range of popular formats, including PDF (.pdf), Microsoft Word (.docx), PowerPoint (.pptx), Excel (.xlsx), Plain Text (.txt), and Subtitle files (.srt).

faqs.q: Will the translated document layout be preserved?
faqs.a: Yes, our document rendering model extracts layout blocks intelligently. Any images, tables, charts, font styles, and columns will remain in their original positions inside the translated file.

A Glossary is a personal terminology dictionary where you define fixed translations for specific brand names, technical jargon, or acronyms. The AI prioritizes your glossary pairs to ensure consistency and precision across all translations.

faqs.q: Can I import glossary terms from spreadsheets?
faqs.a: Yes! You can easily upload an existing spreadsheet dictionary (.csv, .xlsx) to instantly populate your glossary database without entering terms manually.

AnyTrans translations are funded using Credits. Every page or word translated costs a small, fixed amount of credits. A transparent cost estimate is displayed for your approval prior to commencing any translation task.

faqs.q: How do I buy more credits?
faqs.a: Go to Settings > Billing or click the 'Buy Credits' button on the dashboard header. Choose your desired package and pay securely with local bank QR transfers via PayOS/VNPay instantly.
